summary: Completed frontend testing of Chullz Poker - backend APIs work perfectly (100% success), but frontend authentication persistence issues prevent full poker game testing

ui_bugs.issue: Authentication state doesn't persist across page reloads or navigation - users get redirected to profile selection
ui_bugs.details: LocalStorage is empty after login, suggesting tokens aren't being stored. Manual localStorage setting doesn't work either.

ui_bugs.issue: PIN entry buttons have overlay interception issues requiring force clicks
ui_bugs.details: Numeric keypad buttons are not clickable normally due to overlay issues, but work with force=true

integration_issues.issue: Login succeeds temporarily but authentication doesn't persist, preventing access to lobby and poker tables
integration_issues.details: Users can login and briefly see lobby, but any navigation or reload redirects back to profile selection

integration_issues.issue: Cannot test table creation/joining due to authentication persistence issues
integration_issues.details: Authentication issues prevent testing of core poker functionality

passed_tests: Backend API authentication (100% success rate - 25/25 tests)

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix frontend authentication persistence in AuthContext - tokens are not being stored in localStorage and authentication state doesn't persist across page reloads.
